title: AmendmentEvent
description: One amending operation on an Act (PROCUREMENT_PLAN §2.2 Table 1), built from a footnote or from an Act's repeal fields

id.description: Deterministic ID {act_id}:ev:{amending act_id | citation slug | uncited}:{sN | fn-<anchor>-<number> | repeal}, with -2, -3, ... on collision e.g. A1860-45:ev:A2013-13:s9

provisions_affected.description: Section slugs affected: [section_slug] for a linked footnote, [] for an Act-level footnote or a repeal

amending_instrument_id.description: act_id of the amending Act when its citation resolves to an Act in the corpus

amending_citation.description: Amending Act as cited, normalised e.g. Act 13 of 2013, s. 9

assent_date.description: Assent to the amending instrument (from the acts table when it resolves)

publication_date.description: Gazette publication; null until gazette sources exist

commencement_date.description: Date the amendment came into force; null until gazette sources exist

wef_date.description: w.e.f. date as printed in the footnote, or the Act's repeal_date

is_retrospective.description: wef_date earlier than publication_date; null unless both are known

old_text.description: Replaced or omitted wording, when the footnote quotes exactly one un-nested span (for "…" or "…" omitted)

footnote_ids.description: Source footnotes; [] for a repeal event

commencement_notification_id.description: Link into commencement_notifications; null in v0.3.0
